biggest_catch: Playtest invites are irregular and competitive — some testers get a few a month — and the unpaid onboarding qualification test is required before you ever earn.
catches: The Playtester Onboarding qualification test is unpaid.
Playtest invitations are irregular and depend on your profile, gaming preferences and developer demand.
Rewards are not incremental: recording longer than required does not earn more.
If you choose PayPal payout, payment provider Tremendous has introduced a 6% processing fee (per official FAQ) — gift/bank card options avoid it.
You must talk continuously while recording in a quiet room and complete the post-play survey to be paid.
You are told the exact reward in each invitation email — pay varies by test length/complexity.

steps: Sign up as a playtester at playtestcloud.com.
Complete the unpaid onboarding qualification test.
Fill in the 'Reward payment information' section of your profile.
Accept playtest invitations by email (reward stated in each invite).
Play the game 15-30 min while talking your thoughts aloud in a quiet room.
Complete the post-play survey; receive payment within up to 3 days via Tremendous (PayPal, gift card or bank card).
timing: Payment received within up to 3 days after a well-completed playtest (official FAQ), via Tremendous (PayPal / gift card / bank card).

repeatable.cadence: new playtest invitations arrive by email whenever a developer posts a test matching your profile — typically a few a month — and you can accept each one

maximize: Pass the unpaid onboarding qualification test with your best work — only qualified testers get invites. Keep your phone ready and accept playtests fast, since slots are competitive. Speak your thoughts clearly throughout: a well-completed 15-minute playtest pays $5-9, and payment lands via Tremendous (PayPal, gift card, or bank card) within up to 3 days. Check for invites regularly since testers typically get only a few a month.
who_pays: PlaytestCloud pays you through Tremendous, its payment provider. You redeem your reward as PayPal cash, virtual gift or bank cards, or a donation — there’s no minimum payout to reach.
who_qualifies: Anyone can sign up, but you must pass the unpaid onboarding qualification test first. You need a smartphone, tablet, PC or Mac with headphones, a quiet room, and English — plus the ‘Reward payment information’ section of your profile filled in.
work_available: Limited and irregular. Invitations go out by email based on your profile, gaming preferences and developer demand, and testers typically get only a few a month — slots are competitive.
what_gets_accepted: You must complete the playtest well: talk continuously while recording in a quiet room and finish the post-play survey. Recording longer than required doesn’t earn extra.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No costs — PlaytestCloud says it will never ask you to pay. Unpaid time: the onboarding qualification test is unpaid, plus waiting between irregular invites. If you redeem via PayPal, Tremendous charges a 6% processing fee (gift/bank card options avoid it).
when_cash_arrives: Within up to 3 days after a well-completed playtest, paid through Tremendous — redeem as PayPal, virtual gift/bank cards, or a donation.
